system: OAH-Lagos Decision Support Framework (DSS Tropical Adaptation)
disclaimer: Proposal for expert review. Adheres to OAH DSS principle: assists expert judgement, does not replace it.

recommended_measures: Mechanical channel desilting and floating debris extraction
Installation of upstream trash-capture grates at arterial junctions
Hydraulic gradient restoration to eliminate standing pool zones
Targeted application of biological larvicide (e.g. Bacillus thuringiensis israelensis - Bti)
Vegetative shading of open channel banks using native littoral plants
Rapid channel flushing prior to peak breeding cycles
Vetiver grass bio-engineering for bank soil stabilization
Establishment of 5-meter vegetative buffer along earthen stream edges
Enforcement of setback buffer zones against illegal quarrying
